mainEntity.name: What are common energy-efficient upgrades for older homes in the East Bay?

acceptedAnswer.text: For older homes common in areas like Berkeley or Oakland, energy-efficient upgrades often focus on improving the building envelope and HVAC systems. This includes adding insulation to attics, walls, and crawl spaces, replacing single-pane windows with double or triple-pane alternatives, and upgrading to high-efficiency furnaces or heat pumps. We often see significant energy loss through outdated windows and poorly insulated attics in many of the older homes in this region.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common upgrades for older East Bay homes include insulation, replacing single-pane windows, and upgrading HVAC systems. Outdated windows and poor attic insulation are frequent issues.
